senses.gloss: an aperture in the roof looking to the ground floor (answering to the Greek hypaithron, Roman compluvium), contrad. fr. חַלּוֹן a garret window in the wall projecting above the flat roof.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 5:1">Bets. V, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Beitzah 35b:13">35ᵇ</cite>); cmp. Rashi a. l.
Nidd. 20ᵇ כסומא בא׳ like a blind man finding his way down from the ărubbah, i.e. hitting the truth by chance. Ohol. X, 1; a. fr.—Pl. אֲרוּבּוֹת.

senses.gloss: the opening panel of folding doors.—Pl. as supra.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 76a:8">Yoma 76ᵃ</cite>. [<cite ref="Shabbat 43a">Sabb. 43ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 153b">153ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:2">Kel. XV, 2</cite> read with Ar. <he>אֲרוּכוֹת</he>.]
